integrity: Every local covariance is derived from an exact conditional probability after fixing one permutation coordinate. The boundary and cyclic identities are exact sums of those local terms. An exhaustive checker independently reconstructs all formulas through n=9.
scientific_limitations: The permutation is uniform; weighted permutation models need not satisfy the conditional exchangeability used in the proof.
The theorem is a second-moment, position-resolved statement and does not determine higher mixed moments or the full joint law.
Older refined descent enumeration may encode the same local identity indirectly, although the strongest inspected classical source records only total fixed-point counts within descent classes.
title: Boundary localization of fixed-point–descent dependence in a uniform permutation
